results.note: no bet qualified under this rule in the backtest window
results.name: Rec yards OVER (high usage)
results.rule: Prior targets >= 6 and edge >= 8 pts (selective variant).

results.name: Rec yards OVER
results.rule: Receiving yards over our number vs the naive trailing-median line, prior targets >= 4, edge >= 5 pts. Priced at an ASSUMED -110 (see IR-03).

results.name: Rec yards UNDER
results.rule: Mirror of T01 on the under side.

results.name: Receptions OVER
results.rule: Receptions over, prior targets >= 4, edge >= 5 pts, assumed -110.

results.name: Receptions UNDER
results.rule: Mirror of T04 on the under side.

results.name: Rush attempts OVER
results.rule: Carries over for backs with prior carries >= 8, edge >= 5 pts, assumed -110.

results.name: Rush attempts UNDER
results.rule: Mirror of T06 on the under side.

results.name: Prop parlay: two team-mates
results.rule: Both of the top-two receivers on a team clear the edge filter; parlay priced at the product of two -110 legs (27.4% break-even).

results.name: Prop parlay: same player, two markets
results.rule: Same player, targets over AND receptions over; priced at the product of two -110 legs.

assumed_price_note: Prop prices are ASSUMED -110; no verifiable prop price source was available. Hit rates are measured, ROI is conditional on the assumption.
